summary: ImAGEin is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in the biology of ageing, run by Université Côte d'Azur in Nice with the University of Cologne, Sorbonne Université, the University of Seville and the University of Coimbra. Scholarships pay €1,400 a month for 24 months. Applications for the 2027–2029 cohort open on 6 January and close on 6 March 2027.
meta_title: ImAGEin 2027: Erasmus Mundus Biology of Ageing scholarship
meta_description: ImAGEin pays €1,400 a month for a two-year biology of ageing master's in Nice, Cologne, Paris, Seville and Coimbra. Apply from 6 January to 6 March 2027.
covers: €1,400 a month for 24 months, for living, travel, visa and settling-in costs.
Participation costs for the 2027–2029 cohort had not been published on 7 November 2026; the previous cohort paid €10,000 for two years as non-Europeans.
eligibility: Applicants of all nationalities, within the limit on scholarships per nationality.
A bachelor's (180 ECTS) or equivalent in a STEM subject. Final-year students must prove graduation by July 2027.
English: TOEFL iBT, IELTS 6.5 (no part below 6.0), Cambridge CPE or CAE (180), or proof that at least one semester was taught entirely in English. Tests must be less than two years old.
how_to_apply: Apply online between 6 January and 6 March 2027, midnight Paris time.

Upload your ID, STEM diploma with English translation, transcripts with a 4.0 GPA, a motivation letter of up to 500 words, a Europass CV of up to two pages, a training plan ranking three mobility tracks, two English recommendation letters, your English proof and a photo.
Interviews are on 18, 19, 22, 23 and 24 March 2027, and rankings and scholarship offers come in early April. Welcome days are in the first week of September 2027.
watch_out: A medium-of-instruction letter from a Ghanaian or Nigerian university meets the English requirement if it shows your teaching was entirely in English.
The final document list is published from mid-October; check it before you apply.
You are not eligible if the scholarships for your nationality have already been filled.
documents: STEM bachelor's diploma with English translation
Transcripts with GPA on a 4.0 scale

faq.q: When can I apply to ImAGEin?
faq.a: From 6 January to 6 March 2027 at midnight Paris time.
A bachelor's of 180 ECTS or equivalent in a STEM subject.

faq.q: Does ImAGEin accept a medium-of-instruction letter?
faq.a: Yes, as proof that at least one semester was taught entirely in English.
